title: Coefficient of the zero-coordinate slice
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{0,1\}^{n+1}\to\mathbb F_2$, and let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Write $S^+$ for the corresponding set of tail coordinates in the $(n+1)$-dimensional cube. The algebraic normal form coefficient indexed by $S$ of the slice of $f$ whose first coordinate is $0$ equals the coefficient of $f$ indexed by $S^+$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional cube
$S$ is a finite set of coordinates in the $n$-dimensional cube
